cc:Work.dc:title: PurrNet: 67% less estimated GC allocation than FishNet during continuous spawn / despawn. Spawn / despawn · 100 connections · 20 Hz.
cc:Work.dc:description: SpawnChurn: 100 objects kept alive; 2 replaced per tick · 100 connections · 20 Hz · 10 s window · 1 KiB = 1,024 bytes. Allocation is estimated from positive managed-heap growth between frames, not a precise allocation count. One run; no repeat variability measured.
